scope: Two actual Linux Claude Code 2.1.310 Case3A working-interval attempts (R5 and R6), each with synthetic local authentication and scripted model responses. Both failed before a working interval was qualified. No live installation or account changes.
status: R5 and R6 are both FAIL and remain unqualified. R5 invalidated at native requires_action before its fixture permission decision. R6 wrote the exact authorized fixture Allow and observed its matching response plus a same-session running event, but the observation classifier invalidated the stream; no qualified clear, task/run, parent final, working cut, completion, or automatic continuation was established.

R7_correction_preparation.refuse: Unknown, duplicate, or pre-send mismatched events are refused.

limits: The missing working-cut files make outer postcheck fail; this remains a failed actual run, not a repaired receipt.
The history-finalization assertion had no pre-cut history witness to validate; its error is not proof that native history changed.
R5 only: no callback was answered.

The permission-state marker grants no action authority. A correction must keep unresolved human waits blocked, admit only the already authorized exact fixture callback through durable intent, and require an observed clear before publication.
This case does not qualify cancellation, quota recovery, Mac behavior, real-account rotation or UI conversion.
next_step: Prepare the minimal R7 callback correlation correction and review its immutable packet before any further native attempt. Keep R5 and R6 as FAIL; R7 preparation alone is not qualification.
